15.2
Safety device requirements
The power supply must be protected with the required safety
devices, i.e. a main switch, a slow blow fuse on each phase and an
earth leakage protector in accordance with the applicable legislation.
In the power supply line, ALWAYS install a residual current device
(RCD) with an instantaneous action. The installed RCD MUST
comply with the national wiring regulation.

original_query_results.text:
17.4
To perform a test run
1
Close all front panels to prevent misjudgement (except for the
switch box inspection cover).
2
Make sure all field settings you want are set; see "16.1 Making
field settings" [4 32].
3
Turn ON the power to the outdoor unit and the connected
indoor unit(s).
NOTICE
Turn ON the power 6 hours before operation in order to
have power running to the crankcase heater and to protect
the compressor.
4
Make sure the default (idle) situation is existing; see "16.1.4 To
access mode 1 or 2" [4 33]. Push BS2 for 5 seconds or more.
The unit will start test operation.
